text: Participants' momentary happiness will be influenced by rewards obtained in the current trial, expected rewards, reward prediction errors, rewards received in previous trials, and differences between rewards obtained by the participant and the partner.
anchor: Based on previous findings (Rutledge et al., 2016), we reasoned that participants' momentary happiness would be influenced not only by rewards obtained in the current trial, but also by expected rewards, reward prediction errors, rewards received in previous trials, and differences between rewards obtained by the participant and the partner.
